summary: Russia is conducting simultaneous multi-directional Shahed drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, with Kyiv targeted by up to 8 Shaheds from multiple directions while Obukhov, Vasylkiv, and Voskresenka also sustain hits. Ukrainian forces deploy Neptune missiles against a Russian Buran-M caliber launcher vessel and may introduce FP-7 ballistic missiles by late September. Canada pledges $250 million USD in aid and drone production support as Zelensky secures defense, economic, and energy cooperation during international visits.
key_points: Russia launches simultaneous multi-directional Shahed drone attacks targeting Kyiv from north and south, with additional strikes hitting Obukhov, Vasylkiv, Voskresenka, and Dnipro city across multiple regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74257, 74258, 74265, 74271, 74268, 74261)

Ukraine's Neptune missile successfully attacks and damages a Russian Buran-M caliber launcher vessel, causing significant damage and rendering it inoperable until at least year-end. (Source: @UkraineNow/84035)
Ukrainian FP-7 ballistic missiles may see first operational deployment in late September to early October, potentially altering the strategic balance in the air war. (Source: @UkraineNow/84035)

Canada signs century-long partnership with Ukraine approving $350 million CAD ($250 million USD) in aid and creating a drone production program, with one-third of output transferred to Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33169)

The Kremlin prepares potential false-flag provocations on occupied territories during September 18-20 illegal elections, including bombings of polling stations and diversions blamed on Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/84022)

Ukrainian military personnel face phishing attacks via Signal using fake DeepStateMap to deploy malicious software, posing a significant cybersecurity threat with unknown scale of compromise. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23822)

Russian Vostok East grouping UAV operators are reported destroying Ukrainian Armed Forces armored vehicles and ground-based robots in the Zaporizhzhia region, indicating intensified drone warfare. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33160)
Ukraine's Finance Minister warns social benefit and salary payments could halt as the country reaches its fiscal limit, raising concerns about internal stability. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33162)

sections.executive_summary: Russia is conducting simultaneous multi-directional Shahed drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, with Kyiv receiving up to 8 Shaheds from north and south while Obukhov, Vasylkiv, and Voskresenka sustain direct hits causing fires and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian forces strike a Russian Buran-M caliber launcher vessel with Neptune missiles and may deploy FP-7 ballistic missiles by late September. International support intensifies as Canada pledges $250 million USD in aid and drone production, while Latvia accelerates energy equipment transfers ahead of the heating season.

points: Ukrainian forces strike a Russian Buran-M caliber launcher vessel with Neptune missiles, causing significant damage and rendering the ship inoperable until at least the end of the year, according to government reporting. (Source: @UkraineNow/84035)

Ukraine may deploy FP-7 ballistic missiles for the first time in late September to early October, marking a significant escalation in long-range strike capability as acknowledged by President Zelensky. (Source: @UkraineNow/84035)

Ukraine's Finance Minister Marchenko warns that social benefit and salary payments could come to a halt, stating the government has reached its fiscal limit amid ongoing war expenditures. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33162)

Approximately $1.2 billion was lost to fraud, waste, and mismanagement in Ukrainian defense procurement during 2024-2025 according to New York Times reporting, raising concerns about operational resource efficiency. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33166)

Ukrainian military personnel are targeted by phishing campaigns via Signal using fake DeepStateMap to deploy malicious software, with unknown scale of account compromise across the force. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23822)

President Zelensky reports Ukraine needs more time to resolve reactive drone defense challenges, while acknowledging potential negotiation results may emerge in September after Russian state Duma elections. (Source: @UkraineNow/84033)
A Russian drone targeted a gas station in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district, wounding four people and causing a fire in an eight-story non-residential building. (Source: @UkraineNow/84011)

The Kremlin is preparing potential false-flag provocations on occupied territories during September 18-20 illegal elections, including bombings of polling stations, transport diversions, and assassinations of collaborators framed as Ukrainian attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/84022)

Russian forces report UAV operators from the Vostok East grouping destroying Ukrainian Armed Forces armored vehicles and ground-based robots in the Zaporizhzhia region, indicating sustained offensive drone operations. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33160)
Russian Ministry of Defense claims destruction of a British Husky armored vehicle used by Ukrainian forces near Druzhkovka in the DNR region. (Source: @tass_agency/394832)
A Ukrainian drone strike on a car in Shebekino, Belgorod region kills one person and wounds another according to Russian emergency officials. (Source: @tass_agency/394807)
The Machachkala sea port in Dagestan is hit, disrupting a key logistics corridor between Russia and Iran via the Caspian Sea used for sanctions-evasion military shipments. (Source: @UkraineNow/84030)

Russian Telegram channels report a Shahed drone falling on Voskresenka in Kyiv region with an Epicenter store reportedly hit, while another Shahed falls on warehouse facilities near Obukhov. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74271, 74276, 74263)

TASS reports that Kyiv's threats against civilian aviation are aimed at disrupting Russia-US contacts, with analyst Miroshnik describing Washington-Moscow dialogue as an irritant for European efforts. (Source: @tass_agency/394830)

Russian Ministry of Defense claims Ukrainian Armed Forces British Husky armored vehicle destroyed near Druzhkovka in the DNR region, indicating ongoing armored engagements in the eastern sector. (Source: @tass_agency/394832)
DeepStateMap reports Russian forces advancing near Kostyantynivka and Chervone, with map updates reflecting continued frontline movement in the Donetsk direction. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23821)

UAV operators from Russia's Vostok East grouping are reported destroying Ukrainian armored vehicles and ground-based robots in the Zaporizhzhia region, demonstrating intensified drone-based offensive operations. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33160)

Ukrainian military intelligence reports potential mobilization incentives in eastern occupied territories, with TASS citing a captured border guard claiming mobilized Ukrainians could receive $100 thousand to work at TCC. (Source: @tass_agency/394826)
Reconnaissance and drone activity continues along the eastern front with multiple reactive drone movements reported in the Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk border areas. (Source: @kpszsu/77713, 77708)

Kyiv faces mass drone attacks with up to 5 Shaheds expected from the south and 3 from the north, while 4 Shaheds are reported on Kyiv itself according to air defense monitoring. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74257, 74258)

A Shahed drone strikes Vasylkiv in Kyiv region with 2 reportedly shot down in the area, while another falls on Voskresenka in the Darnytsky district of Kyiv flying from Lower Sady toward Poznyaky. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74262, 74267)

A Shahed drone hits an Epicenter store in Vasylkiv district of Kyiv region, and another strikes warehouse facilities on the outskirts of Obukhov, causing fires and infrastructure damage. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74276, 74263)
A fire breaks out in a 9-story residential building in the Dnipro district of Kyiv as a result of enemy attack, according to local reporting. (Source: @eRadarrua/112501)

A Shahed drone from Chernihiv region enters Kyiv region heading toward Vysohrod district, while another from Dnipropetrovsk heads toward Poltava district, demonstrating multi-axis northern threats. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74277)

A Shahed drone strikes a gas station in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district wounding four people, while a separate drone targets an 8-story non-residential building causing a fire. (Source: @UkraineNow/84011)
A strong fire breaks out in Buchan district of Kyiv region following a Russian attack according to local media reports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84034)
